entries.3b3b6322c65adeae: This business delivers evening meal ingredients and sells food for business use. Home delivery of evening meal ingredients is provided to general households in Aichi, Gifu and Mie Prefectures in the Chubu region, and in parts of Kyoto, Osaka and Shiga Prefectures in the Kansai region. It uses an integrated delivery system in which products are manufactured at the company's own factories and sold and delivered by sales staff, and it also conducts food research and product development. Sales results for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥5,512 million for menu products and ¥495 million for special-offer products.
